meanings: he abstained from it (meaning from something that would gratify the passions or senses), relinquished it, forsook it, shunned it or avoided it, did not desire it, he computed or determined its quantity/measure/size/bulk/proportion/amount/sum/number or computed by conjecture its quantity/amount, become undesired due to littleness/worth, he reckoned it little, to despise, a small quantity, a narrow valley that receives little water.

occurrences.verseArabic: وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوا فِيهِ مِنَ الزَّاهِدِينَ
occurrences.verseTransliteration: Ve şerevhu bi semenin bahsin derâhime ma’dûdeh(ma’dûdetin), ve kânû fîhi minez zâhidîn(zâhidîne).
occurrences.verseMeaning: Onu basit bir karşılıkla, birkaç paraya sattılar. Ona fazla rağbet gösterenler değillerdi.
